+def _resolve_corpus(path: str) -> tuple[Path, str]:
+    normalized = path.replace("\\", "/")
+    marker = "full-corpus/"
+    if marker not in normalized:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"path outside authenticated corpus: {path}")
+    relative = normalized.split(marker, 1)[1]
+    if not relative or relative.startswith("../") or "/../" in relative:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe corpus path: {path}")
+    return CORPUS_ROOT / relative, f"full-corpus/{relative}"

+def _image_ref(item: Mapping[str, Any], *, kind: str, qid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path, portable = _resolve_corpus(item["image_path"])
+    raw = path.read_bytes()
+    actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+    if actual != item["image_sha256"]:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"physical image SHA-256 drift: {path}")
+    return {
+        "image_kind": kind,
+        "page_number": item["page_number"],
+        "path": portable,
+        "question_id": qid,
+        "sha256": actual,

+def _canonical_question_sort_key(question_id: str) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(
+        r"qrow_9709_([msw])(\d{2})_qp_(\d{2})_q(\d{2})",
+        question_id,
+    )
+    if match is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected Probability question identity: {question_id}")
+    session, year_text, component_text, question_text = match.groups()
+    year = int(year_text)
+    return (
+        0 if year >= 20 else 1,
+        {"m": 0, "s": 1, "w": 2}[session],
+        year,
+        int(component_text),
+        int(question_text),
+    )

+        raise RuntimeError("Probability inactive source-map surplus drifted")

+def _load_bundles(inventory: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], int, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    pointers = _active_bundle_pointers()
+    bundles: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    images: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    total_bytes = 0
+    for qid in inventory:
+        pointer = pointers[qid]
+        path, portable = _resolve_corpus(pointer["path"])
+        raw = path.read_bytes()
+        actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+        if actual != pointer["sha256"] or len(raw) != pointer["byte_length"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"active bundle raw-byte drift: {path}")
+        document = json.loads(raw)
+        qp = [_image_ref(item, kind="qp", qid=qid) for item in document["qp_complete_page_chain"]]
+        ms = [_image_ref(item, kind="ms", qid=qid) for item in document["ms_complete_page_chain"]]
+        images.extend(qp)
+        images.extend(ms)
+        bundles[qid] = {
+            "active_bundle_identity": document["packet_id"],
+            "bundle_path": portable,
+            "bundle_sha256": actual,
+            "qp_page_refs": qp,
+            "ms_page_refs": ms,
+        }
+        total_bytes += len(raw)
+    if len(images) != 421 or len({item["path"] for item in images}) != 421:
+        raise RuntimeError("exact-image Probability review inventory drifted")
+    return bundles, total_bytes, images
